subject: The AI predictions Premium users see that you don't
body_paragraphs: I noticed you've been using Predictify for a couple of weeks now. You probably know by now — the AI is good. But here's what most free users never realize: Premium users see a completely different layer of the analysis.

The free version shows you the AI's prediction. Premium shows you HOW the AI got there. The xG breakdowns. The defensive shape analysis. The tactical mismatches that turn into goals. And critically — the high-confidence picks (the ones rated above 85% by the model) are Premium-only. Those are the ones hitting at 78% accuracy this season.

I'm not telling you to subscribe right now. I'm telling you that for the price of one beer, you get to see the picks the AI is actually most certain about — instead of the watered-down free tier. Most Premium users start with the 7-day free trial, see the difference within their first weekend of matches, and never go back.

Tap below to start the trial. If it doesn't blow you away in the first 48 hours, just cancel — you're not charged a cent. P.S. The high-confidence picks for this weekend are already loaded. Premium users are looking at them right now.
